_about: What Atlas Evolution knows about well-known Hermes plugins beyond Hermes' own catalog. role: the job a plugin does; exclusive: only one plugin of a profile should do it; protect: never the one the plugin suggests turning off; transforms: tools whose results it changes. Verified against each plugin's source.

security-guidance.summary_en: Bundled with Hermes: appends a security warning to file writes whose new content matches known-dangerous patterns (pickle.load, eval, verify=False, ...).
security-guidance.summary_pt: Vem com o Hermes: junta um aviso de segurança à gravação de arquivo quando o conteúdo novo tem padrões perigosos conhecidos (pickle.load, eval, verify=False, ...).

rtk-rewrite.summary_en: Rewrites terminal commands through RTK so command output costs fewer tokens.
rtk-rewrite.summary_pt: Reescreve os comandos do terminal pelo RTK para a saída dos comandos gastar menos tokens.
